segments.comment: An elven Ranger takes timed Warning from #wizintrinsic, wields a wished Sting and opens ^X. attrib.c from_what(WARNING) asks artifact.c what_gives() whatever the extrinsic bits hold; Sting's SPFX_WARN matches while wielded, so C prints "You are warned because of Sting." Seed, date, character and the source of Warning chosen independently of the batch 14 pilot.
